Title: AI Cost Calculator UI
Summary: An operator-facing AI Cost Calculator UI that ESTIMATES the expected monetary cost of a model/provider configuration BEFORE execution. Calculation/UI only -- the calculator never executes a provider/model, never makes a paid API call, never makes a network call. Single self-contained interactive HTML artifact; every token->cost number comes READ-ONLY from DB-M16 Calculate-AiAttemptCost (authoritative engine) -- no pricing formula, exchange rate, or rate is invented or duplicated. DB-M14 catalogue drives provider/route/model selectors with UnderlyingModelId + GatewayProviderId preserved separately (OpenRouter identity never collapsed); DB-M15 pricing version (record id + status NEEDS_REVIEW for the effective anthropic record at ref time + effective window) always shown, missing/stale is an explicit PRICE_NOT_FOUND/PRICE_UNKNOWN/LOCAL_COST_UNKNOWN state; DB-M16 ESTIMATED semantics (uncached input at input price, cached at cached rate, output at output price, reasoning billed INCLUDED_IN_OUTPUT never double-charged, cache-write never billed on an ESTIMATE -- null + explicit CacheWriteBillingNote, never a fabricated zero; USD identity or INR via effective fx-usdinr-dev-v2 83.5: 0.0310 USD -> 2.5885 INR; per-attempt 0.0310, multi-attempt 3x = 0.0930); LOCAL != FREE (LOCAL_COST_UNKNOWN never shown as a real zero); escalation path is a read-only per-step DB-M16 simulation with cumulative totals (sonnet 0.04 -> haiku 0.02 -> cum 0.06), SimulationOnly and RoutingPolicyUnmodified always true; quality panel is DB-M25/DB-M24 observed evidence with confidence category + sample (30 chains -> MODERATE, observed/expected cost per verified success 3.5, basis OBSERVED_CHAINS; low confidence explicitly labelled not statistically reliable; no evidence -> honest no-evidence note); budget context is DB-M21 informational only (TASK limit 100, projected 2.5885 INR / 2.59% consumed, ALLOW; an over-limit attempt surfaces BLOCK_BUDGET_EXCEEDED / REQUIRE_HUMAN_OVERRIDE yet OverrideAllowed=false -- the calculator never grants, modifies, or overrides a budget and never executes an attempt). S1-S46: UI opens + selector/route/model/underlying/pricing-version display, token-cost arithmetic, USD/INR, actual-vs-estimated, missing/local/gateway semantics, reasoning billing, quality metrics, escalation chain, budget informational view, capability proofs (no override/routing/pricing/health/execution/network capability), child-suite regressions (M16/M21/M23/M24/M25 green; M26 preserved at its current external signature), DB-M18.1 preserved, Lane C UI byte-identical, solution build 0 errors, and frozen files/config/workbook SHA-256 byte-identical after the run. AUTO_EXECUTION_ENABLED=FALSE; provider/model executed NO; paid calls 0; network calls 0.
